def: Open-source, Kubernetes-native distributed inference stack, a CNCF Sandbox project as of November 2026, that pairs vLLM with cache-aware routing, prefill-decode disaggregation, wide expert parallelism and tiered prefix caching.
practice: Its router conforms to the Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension, with an endpoint picker that scores pods by load and KV-cache affinity; SGLang and TensorRT-LLM are also supported.
